kvai.complete.description: Calls a model with a context and returns its answer, streaming deltas to the root job.
kvai.provider.list.description: Lists the built-in and custom providers, with whether each key is set.
kvai.provider.add.description: Adds or replaces a custom provider, called over a wire API or through a delegate command.
kvai.provider.remove.description: Removes a custom provider and its models.
kvai.model.list.description: Lists the built-in and custom models, of one provider or of all.
kvai.model.add.description: Adds or replaces a model of a custom provider.
kvai.usage.get.description: Lists this workspace's tokens and cost per model.
kvai.usage.total.get.description: Gives this workspace's tokens and cost over every model.
kvai.ui.get.description: Gives kvai's UI: the Models page and the usage status item.
kvai.defaultModel.description: The model kvai.complete uses when a call names none.
kvai.errors.KEY_MISSING: The API key of the provider {provider} isn't set. Set the kvai secret {provider}.apiKey in Settings.
kvai.errors.NO_MODEL: No model was given, and no default model is set.
kvai.errors.RATE_LIMITED: The provider of {model} is limiting calls. Try again later.
kvai.errors.CONTEXT_TOO_LONG: The conversation is too long for {model}.
kvai.errors.BUILT_IN: {id} is built in and can't be changed or removed.
kvai.provider.add.fields.title: Title
kvai.model.add.fields.name: Name
kvai.ui.models.title: Models
kvai.ui.columns.title: Title
kvai.ui.columns.name: Name
kvai.ui.providers.addHelp: A provider speaks a wire API to its base URL, such as Ollama or vLLM. Set its key as the kvai secret <id>.apiKey in Settings.
